integrity: Unrestricted mathematical proof and small finite exhaustive checks are included; independent mathematical, originality and priority validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite Gödel chains equipped with Pelaitay–Zuluaga positive tense Heyting operators including T0; no analogous theorem is asserted for arbitrary DLI implication or negative-tense structures. First six numerical rows are enumerated while the recurrence is proved for every size.
title: Congruence cuts and renewal spectra of finite tense Heyting chains
